 Mary Stoiana goes for her fourth straight win in Osaka as she takes on Moyuka Uchijima in the second round.
 Current Form:
 Mary Stoiana has won three in a row in Osaka. The American qualifier booked her ticket to the round of 16 with an impressive 6-2, 6-3 win over Oleksandra Oliynykova in the first round. Stoiana defeated a pair of Japanese opponents (Rinko Matsuda and Sayaka Ishii) to qualify for the main draw of this WTA 250 event.
 Moyuka Uchijima gutted out a three-set win over fellow Japanese wildcard Ena Shibahara 6-4, 6-7, 6-3, in Osaka. The win not only ended Uchijima’s 4-match losing streak, but it also gave the Japanese player her first win in the Asian swing this year.
The Matchup: DraftKings has posted Stoiana as the favorite at -179 ahead of her first meeting with Uchijima

 Our Mary Stoiana vs Moyuka Uchijima Prediction
 Key Stats: Mary Stoiana has not dropped a set so far in Osaka. Despite already conceding 14 service breaks in this tournament, Stoiana has converted 21 of 39 break points across 3 matches. Stoiana is 11-2 in second-round matches in 2026.
 What to Expect: Stoiana gets a close win over Uchijima. Stoiana has the tools to neutralize Uchijima’s first serves, including a backhand slice that keeps the ball low and skirts out of the hitting zone. Uchijima, who heavily relies on her serve to set up her points, faced 11 break points in her opening match. Uchijima cannot afford to let Stoiana generate that many break chances because she can convert most of them with her solid return positioning.
 Fearless Forecast: Mary Stoiana wins 7-6, 6-4
